label: SD1
algorithm_variant_paper: hybrid quantum Wasserstein GAN (quantum generator + classical discriminator)

parameters.task: load lognormal distribution into 5-qubit quantum generator (proxy for option payoff loading); QAE on top to estimate amplitude

paper_claimed.claimed_speedup: O(poly(n)) loading vs O(2^n) prior state-preparation methods (theoretical)

notes: SD1 is tagged 'other-gate-based' in the P3 extraction but is in fact a QGAN; we use the B5 QGAN+QAE template (generator + canonical QAE). Bare = generator only (paper-reported circuit). Full = generator-loaded state + canonical QAE. Classical baseline = closed-form lognormal-mean (matches B5).
